name: contraction_duality_contract_cl22
description: Host-first V4.1 corpus for exact left/right contractions and an explicit Cl(2,2) pseudoscalar duality contract.

operator_contract.left_contraction: A_r lcontract B_s := <reverse(A_r) B_s>_{s-r} for r <= s, otherwise 0; extend bilinearly by grade decomposition
operator_contract.right_contraction: A_r rcontract B_s := <A_r reverse(B_s)>_{r-s} for r >= s, otherwise 0; extend bilinearly by grade decomposition
operator_contract.duality_backend_status: contract-checked; blade-constant AST support required before relation generation
